question: Find the time taken by a 450 m long train travelling at the speed of 80 km/h to cross a platform of length 150 m.
solution:
**Given:**

A 450 m long train travelling at the speed of 80 km/h crosses a platform of length 150 m.

**Formula used:**

Time taken = frac{{distance traveled}}{{speed}}

**Calculation:**

Time taken = ((450+150)×60×60)/(80×1000)=27s 

**∴ The time taken by a 450 m long train travelling at the speed of 80 km/h to cross a platform of length 150 m is 72 seconds.**
